forum.title: Timer cascading not working as expected
forum.best_answer_content:
Read out and check/post content of the TIM registers.

I don't use Cube/HAL, but this

htim22.Init.Period = 0;

[may be wrong](http://www.efton.sk/STM32/gotcha/g8.html).

JW
